description: This file defines a controller class 'Language' within the OpenCart e-commerce framework. It handles displaying and updating language selection for the storefront, including rendering language options and saving language preferences via AJAX.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class managing the display and saving of language preferences for the storefront.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles loading language data, preparing the data array, and rendering the language selection view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to save a user's language preference, validates input, updates session and URL state, and returns JSON response.
